questions.question: In 5 subjects of 100 marks each, a student gets an average of 62 marks and his average in the first four subjects is 5 less than the marks in the fifth subject. How many marks does he get in the fifth subject?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average marks in 5 subjects = 62

Average marks in the first four subjects are 5 less than the marks in the fifth subject

**Formula used:**

Sum of marks in 5 subjects = Average marks × Number of subjects

**Calculations:**

Sum of marks in 5 subjects = 62 × 5

⇒ Sum of marks in 5 subjects = 310

Let the marks in the fifth subject be x.

Then, average marks in the first four subjects = x - 5

Sum of marks in the first four subjects = (x - 5) × 4

⇒ Sum of marks in the first four subjects = 4x - 20

Sum of marks in the first four subjects + Marks in the fifth subject = 310

⇒ 4x - 20 + x = 310

⇒ 5x - 20 = 310

⇒ 5x = 310 + 20

⇒ 5x = 330

⇒ x = 330 / 5

⇒ x = 66

**∴ The correct answer is 66.**

questions.question: The average of 11 numbers is 7.5. What should be the 12th number added to them to make the average 8.5?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average of 11 numbers: 7.5

Desired average after adding the 12th number: 8.5

**Concept:**

The 12th number can be found by multiplying the desired average by 12 and then subtracting the sum of the first 11 numbers.

**Solution:**

Sum of first 11 numbers = 7.5 × 11 ⇒ 82.5

12th number = 8.5 × 12 - 82.5 ⇒ 19.5

**Therefore, the 12th number should be 19.5 to make the average 8.5.**

questions.question: P ∶ Q = 4 ∶ 5 and R is 15% less than Q. If Q = 300, then what is the sum of P and R?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Q = 300 and P : Q = 4 : 5.

**Calculation:**

So, Q = 300 and P : Q = 4 : 5.

P = (4/5)Q = (4/5) x 300 = 240.

Also, R is 15% less than Q.

⇒ R = Q - 15% of Q

⇒ R = Q - 0.15Q

⇒ R = 0.85Q

Substituting the value of Q, we get:

⇒ R = 0.85 x 300 = 255

So, the sum of P and R is:

⇒ P + R = 240 + 255 = 495

**Therefore, the sum of P and R is 495.**

questions.question: Two classes M and N have average marks 25 and 40 respectively. The overall average obtained is 30. The ratio of the students in the class M and N is:

The sum of marks obtained by all students in class M = 25x

Again, according to question

(25x + 40y)/(x + y) = 30

⇒ 25x + 40y = 30x + 30y

⇒ 10y = 5x

⇒ x : y = 2 : 1

∴ The ratio of number of students of class M and class N are in the ratio 2 : 1

questions.question: On mixing two classes A and B of students having average marks 50 and 80, respectively, the average marks obtained is 60. Find the respective ratio of the students in the classes A and B.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average marks of class A = 50

Average marks of class B = 80

Combined average marks = 60

**Solution:**

⇒ Ratio of students in classes A and B = (Average of B - Combined average) ∶ (Combined average - Average of A)

⇒ Ratio of students in classes A and B = (80 - 60) ∶ (60 - 50) = 20 ∶ 10 = 2 ∶ 1

**Hence, the ratio of the students in classes A and B is 2 ∶ 1.**

questions.question: The average weight of 20 students in a group is 54 kg. If 12 students of average weight 52 kg join the group and 7 students of average weight 56 kg leave the group, then what will be the average weight (in kg) of the remaining students in the group?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Average weight of 20 students = 54 kg

Average weight of 12 students = 52 kg

Average weight of 7 students = 56 kg

**Formula used:-**

Average = (Sum of all weight)/(Total no. of weight)

**Calculation:-**

According to question-

⇒ (Sum of 20 students)/20 = 54

⇒ Sum of 20 students = 54 × 20

⇒ Sum of 20 students = 1080

∴ Sum of 12 students = 52 × 12

⇒ Sum of 12 students = 624

⇒ Sum of 7 students = 56 × 7

⇒ Sum of 7 students = 392

Average of remaining students = (Sum of 20 students + Sum of 12 students - Sum of 7 students)/(20 + 12 - 7)

Average of remaining students = (1080 + 624 - 392)/25

Average of remaining students = 1312/25 = 52.48

∴ **Average of remaining students is 52.48. **

questions.question: Average price of 20 pens is Rs. 18. If 12 new pens are added, then the average price rise by Rs. 4. What is the total price of the new pens?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of pens = 20

Average price of 20 pens = Rs. 18

Number of new pens added = 12

Increase in average price = Rs. 4

**Formula:**

Total price of pens = Number of pens × Average price

**Calculation:**

Total price of 20 pens = 20 × 18 = Rs. 360

Total price of 32 pens (20 old + 12 new) = 32 × (18 + 4) = 32 × 22 = Rs. 704

Total price of new pens = Total price of 32 pens - Total price of 20 pens = Rs. 704 - Rs. 360 = Rs. 344

**The total price of the new pens is Rs. 344.**

questions.question: The average marks of 100 students in a class were 80. The average marks of the top 15 students and the bottom 15 students in the merit list were 84 and 74, respectively. Find the average marks of the remaining students (correct to two decimal places).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average marks of 100 students were 80.

The average marks of the top 15 students is 84

and the average of the bottom 15 students is 74.

**Concept Used:**

No. of students × Average marks = Total obtained marks of the students

**Calculation:**

The total marks of 100 students = 100** **× 80

⇒ 8000 

The total marks of Top 15 students = 84 × 15

⇒ 1260

The total marks of Bottom 15 students = 74 × 15 

⇒ 1110 

So, total number of (15 + 15) = 30 students

⇒ Total marks of those 30 students = (1260 + 1110)

⇒ 2370

Total number of remaining students = (100 - 30)

⇒ 70 students

Total marks of remaining 70 students = Total marks of 100 students - Total marks of 30 students

⇒ (8000 - 2370)

⇒ 5630

So, the average marks of the remaining 70 students = 5630/70 = 80.43

**∴** **T****he average marks of the remaining students is** **80.43**

T + W = 39.4 times 2 = 78.8°C (2)

M + T + W = 38.1 times 3 = 114.3°C (3)

(1) + (2) - (3), we get

S = 74.4 + 78.8 - 114.3 = 38.9°C

**Temperature on Sunday is 38.9°C**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Given:-

4 consecutive odd numbers = a, b, c, d

Average of a, b, c, d = 18

**Formula used:-**

Average of consecutive numbers = (First number + Last number)/2

**Calculation:-**

Average of consecutive odd numbers a, b, c, d = (a + d)/2

⇒ a + d = 18 × 2 = 36

According to question-

⇒ (a + d) + (b + c) = 18 × 4

⇒ b + c = 72 - 36 = 36

∴ Average of b and c = (b + c)/2

Average of b and c = 36/2 = 18

∴ **Average of b and c is 18. **

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold big, medium and small sized bulbs for Rs. 150, Rs. 80 and Rs. 50 respectively. The total number of bulbs sold were in the ratio of 2 ∶ 7 ∶ 11. What is the average price paid for a bulb?
questions.solution:
Let the total number of bulbs be 2x, 7x and 11x.

Then,

Total price of Big bulbs = 150 × 2x = 300x

Total price of Medium bulbs = 80 × 7x = 560x

Total price of Small bulbs = 50 × 11x = 550x

Average cost of bulbs = (300x + 560x + 550x)/20x = 1410/20 = 70.5

questions.question: Rashmi brought 50 books at the rate of Rs. 80 each, 46 pens at the rate of Rs. 60 each, and 60 pencils at the rate of Rs. 30 each. Calculate the average price (in Rs.) of all the stationary goods. (Rounded up to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given: **

50 books at Rs. 80 each,

46 pens at Rs. 60 each,

60 pencils at Rs. 30 each

**Concept: **

Average price = Total price / Total items

**Calculation:**

Calculate the total cost for books, pens, and pencils.

⇒ Total cost = (50 books × Rs. 80/book) + (46 pens × Rs. 60/pen) + (60 pencils × Rs. 30/pencil)

⇒ Total cost = Rs. 4000 + Rs. 2760 + Rs. 1800

⇒ Total cost = Rs. 8560

Calculate the total quantity of all stationary goods.

⇒ Total quantity = 50 books + 46 pens + 60 pencils

⇒ Total quantity = 156 items

Calculate the average price.

⇒ Average price = Total cost / Total quantity

⇒ Average price = Rs. 8560 / 156 items

⇒ Average price ≈ Rs. 54.87 (rounded to 2 decimal places)

**Therefore, the average price of all the stationary goods is approximately Rs. 54.87.**

questions.question: The average of the first four prime numbers that are odd is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Prime numbers 3, 5, 7, 11

Concept used:

Average is calculated by summing up the given numbers and dividing by the count of numbers.

Solution:

Sum of the four prime numbers = 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 = 26

Average = Sum of numbers / Number of numbers

⇒ 26 / 4 = 6.5

**Therefore, the average of the first four prime numbers that are odd is 6.5.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__**1 can only be divided by one number, 1 itself, so with this definition 1 is not a prime number.

questions.question: 4 years ago, the average age of a family of 4 members was 19 years. A baby having been born, the average age of the family is the same today. Find the present age of the baby.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Present average age of 4 older members = 19 + 4 = 23 years.

Total age of these 4 members today = 23 × 4 = 92 years.

Total age of 5 members today (including baby) = 19 × 5 = 95 years.

Present age of the baby = 95 − 92 = 3 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of a family of 4 members 4 years ago = 19 years

Current average age of the family (5 members including baby) = 19 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

 
 4 Years Ago

 Sum = 76
 
•

 Present
 4 Members = 92
 5 Members = 95
 Baby's Age = 95 − 92 = 3 Years

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 4 members 4 years ago = 4 × 19 = 76 years

⇒ After 4 years, each member's age increases by 4 years.

⇒ Total increase in age of 4 members = 4 × 4 = 16 years

⇒ Present total age of the 4 original members = 76 + 16 = 92 years

⇒ Total members in the family today = 4 + 1 (baby) = 5 members

⇒ Present total age of 5 members = 5 × 19 = 95 years

⇒ Present age of the baby = Total present age of 5 members − Total present age of 4 members

⇒ Present age of the baby = 95 − 92 = 3 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Change in Average over Time

If the average age of a group is A years, then after t years, the new average age of the same group becomes (A + t) years, provided no member leaves or joins.

Inclusion of a New Member

Age of new member = Total age of new group − Total age of old group at present. This is frequently used when a baby is born or a new person joins a group.

Combined Average

The combined average of two groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ and averages A₁ and A₂ respectively is given by (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: The average of 13 numbers is 42. If a 14th number is included, then the average becomes 44. What is the 14th number?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of 14 numbers = 14 × 44 = 616

questions.question: The average of 2 numbers is ab. If one of the number is a, the other is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 2 numbers is ab.

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of the terms/Number of the terms)

**Calculation:**

Let the number be x.

**According to the question:**

(a + x)/2 = ab

⇒ a + x = 2ab

⇒ x = 2ab - a

**∴ The other number be 2ab - a **

questions.question: The average score of a group of students in a test is 64. If 20% students obtained an average score of 91 and 25% students obtained an average score of 31, then what is the average score (correct to one decimal place) of the remaining students?
questions.solution:
**Concept Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of observation

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of students in a group be N.

Total score of group = 64N

Total score of 20% students = 20N/100 × 91

Total score of 25% students = 25N/100 × 31

Total score of 55% students = 64N - (20N/100 × 91 + 25N/100 × 31) = 38.05N

**∴ Required average = 38.05N/(55N/100) = 69.2**

questions.question: If the average of 20, 25,(p + 1), (2p + 5) and (p + 11) is 22, then the value of p is :
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Average = Sum of elements ÷ Total number of elements

**Calculation:**

Sum of elements = 20 + 25 + (p + 1) + (2p + 5) + (p + 11) = 62 + 4p

Total number of elements = 5

According to the question-

⇒ 62+4pover5 = 22

⇒ 62 + 4p = 22 × 5

⇒ 4p = 110 - 62

⇒ 4p = 48

⇒ p = 12

∴ **The value of p is 12.**

questions.question: the average of nine consecutive even numbers is 24. What is the average of the smallest three of these 9 given numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:-

 The average of nine consecutive even numbers is 24.

Formula used:- 

Average = {Sum of Observations} ÷ {Total number of Observations}.

Calculation:- 

Let's assume nine consecutive even numbers are y, (y+2), (y+4),

(y+6), (y+8), (y+10), (y+12), (y+14) and (y+16).... 

The average of nine consecutive even numbers is 24 

Average = {Sum of Observations} ÷ {Total number of Observations}. 

⇒ [ y + (y + 2) + ( y + 4).........+( y + 16) ]/9 = 24 

⇒ 9y + 72 = 24 × 9 

⇒ 9y = 216 - 72 

⇒ y = 16 

Average of the smallest three of these 9 given numbers

= [ y+ (y+2)+ (y+4)]/3 = [3y + 6]/2 = y + 2

Put the value y above the equation 

⇒ 16 + 2 = 18 

∴ The required answer is 18.

questions.question: The average weight of 25 boxes in a boat is increased by 2 kg when one of the boxes weighing 68 kg is replaced by a new box. The weight (in kg) of the new box is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weight of the old box = 68 kg

Increase in the average weight of 25 boxes = 2 kg

**Concept used:**

Total weight = Average weight × Number of boxes

**Calculation:**

Let the average weight of 25 boxes be x kg and the weight of the new box be y kg respectively.

Total weight of 25 boxes = (25 × x) = 25x

According to the question

⇒ (25x – 68 + y)/25 = x + 2

⇒ (25x – 68 + y) = 25x + 50

⇒ y = 50 + 68

⇒ y = 118

**∴ The weight of the new box is 118 kg**

questions.question: Average of 50 numbers was calculated as 20 when three numbers 26, 36 and 64 were wrongly read as 31, 46 and 59 respectively. What is the correct average?
questions.solution:
Average of 50 numbers = 20

⇒ Sum of 50 numbers = 50 × 20 = 1000

⇒ Right numbers = 26 + 36 + 64 = 126

⇒ Wrong numbers = 31 + 46 + 59 = 136

⇒ Difference = 126 – 136 = 10

⇒ Now the correct sum of 50 numbers = 1000 – 10 = 990

⇒ Correct average of 50 numbers = 990/50 = 19.8

∴ The correct average is 19.8

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is 8. If each number is multiplied by 10, then the new average will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If every observation in a dataset is multiplied by a constant k, the new average is simply the old average multiplied by k.

Old average = 8

Constant multiplier = 10

New average = 8 × 10 = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 10 numbers = 8

Multiplier for each number = 10

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all numbers ÷ Total count of numbers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5300089b3b3c887596bd66d0fc303b520d088857f3a2f05ef83c5dfc3dc8b428.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the 10 numbers be x₁, x₂, ..., x₁₀

⇒ Sum of the original numbers = x₁ + x₂ + ... + x₁₀ = 8 × 10 = 80

⇒ When each number is multiplied by 10, the new numbers are 10x₁, 10x₂, ..., 10x₁₀

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = 10x₁ + 10x₂ + ... + 10x₁₀

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = 10 × (x₁ + x₂ + ... + x₁₀)

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = 10 × 80 = 800

⇒ New average = Sum of the new numbers ÷ 10

⇒ New average = 800 ÷ 10 = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Addition & Subtraction Property of Averages

If a constant value 'c' is added to or subtracted from every number in a dataset, the new average becomes (Original Average ± c).

Multiplication & Division Property of Averages

If every number in a dataset is multiplied or divided by a non-zero constant 'k', the new average becomes (Original Average × k) or (Original Average ÷ k).

Combined Average

For two separate groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ and individual averages A₁ and A₂, the Combined Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p

questions.question: The average height of P, Q and R is 160 cm. If the average height of P and Q is 140 cm and that of Q and R is 129 cm, then what is the height of Q?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

The average height of P, Q, and R is 160 cm 

The average height of P and Q is 140 cm 

The average height of R and Q is 129 cm

**Formula used:-** 

Average = Sum of Values/Number of Values

**Calculation:- ** 

⇒ (P + Q + R)/3 = 160 

⇒ (P + Q + R) = 480 

Similarly, 

⇒ (P + Q)/2 = 140 

⇒ (P + Q) = 280

⇒ R = (P + Q + R) - (P + Q) 

⇒ R = 480 - 280 = 200 

Similarly, 

⇒ (Q + R)/2 = 129 

⇒ Q + R = 258 

⇒ Q = 258 - 200 = 58 cm 

**∴**** The required answer is __58__ cm.**

questions.question: The average weight of 23 students was recorded as 53 kg. On including the weight of a teacher, the average weight increased by 100 g. Find the weight (in kg) of the teacher.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the average increase to kg: 100 g = 100 ÷ 1000 = **0.1 kg**.

New total number of people = 23 students + 1 teacher = **24 people**.

Weight of the teacher = Old Average + (New Total People × Increase in Average)

Weight = 53 + (24 × 0.1) = 53 + 2.4 = **55.4 kg**.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.4 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of **students** (n₁) = 23 | Initial **Average** (A₁) = 53 kg

**Increase** in average = 100 g = 0.1 kg | New Average (A₂) = 53 + 0.1 = 53.1 kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ae1f1a13dd58636cb3285ebf095eac125601e69e4bc79d6f9e58be1159eeea1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of 23 students = 23 × 53 = 1219 kg

⇒ Total number of persons including teacher = 23 + 1 = 24

⇒ New Average = 53 + 0.1 = 53.1 kg

⇒ Total weight of 24 persons = 24 × 53.1 = 1274.4 kg

⇒ Weight of the teacher = Total weight of 24 persons − Total weight of 23 students

⇒ Weight of teacher = 1274.4 − 1219 = 55.4 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 55.4 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Calculation Formula

The basic formula for average is Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Newcomer's Weight Rule

When a new person joins a group, the Weight of Newcomer = New Average + (Old Strength × Change in Average).

Net Deviation Concept

The sum of deviations of all items from their arithmetic mean is always zero. This is useful for finding missing values in a data set.</p
